task.title: Finally verify limited recovery and the sole-admin fallback
task.input: Delivered recovery UI/OS-owner CLI, one-time codes and restricted-cookie protocol
task.output: admin-acceptance: concurrent recovery, privilege isolation and local fallback evidence
task.accept: 1) From the independent recovery entry, POST /api/auth-admin/recovery/start, enroll and confirm. Concurrent consumption of identical or different recovery codes never revives a used code. A restricted cookie cannot access admin. Interruption/expiry preserves old valid factors, reentry returns the same URI/deadline, and only final confirmation replaces factors followed by ordinary login (E-10, E-11, E-14). 2) When no second admin or recovery code exists, run the actual OS-owner TTY CLI on an isolated server with explicit target/reason to create a permit. A hidden-input password preauthorization commits only with final new-TOTP confirmation and audit. Do not weaken old first-enrollment reset-script guards; an anonymous browser cannot issue permits or change passwords. Final confirm revokes old sessions/factors/recovery materials, displays new codes once, and rejects the next request from old devices (E-15).
